items.text: Nama fiixaanii baasa. Hammam caalaa itti yaaddu, hammuma fiixaan si baasa.
items.q: A student's crude slang for 'it makes your head spin' (like 'shit-dizzy'). Is there a crude word here? Which would a young person use?

items.text: Atis, haala dubbii kee kan akka qulaa kanaan, maqaan kee Alain Qulalon taʼuu qaba ture.
items.q: 'Alain Qulalon' is meant as a rude pun on the actor Alain Delon. Would Oromo readers get it? If not, what word could carry it?
before: – Ee, Hamoon maqaa gaarii dha siif. Akka Hamoon fiilmii keessaa, atis gaaffiidhaan guutamteerta. Yaaddoo fi madda jeeqamaatiin guutamteerta — ofii keetiif utuu hin taane, anaaf.

items.text: Bokkaan lafaa gara samiitti hin roobu.
items.q: Her son says he would die for her; Maman objects. An old Persian proverb kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Harki koo gabaabaa dha, walitti dhufeenyi kees fagoo dha.
items.q: Amir tells the girl he loves why he holds back. A Persian expression kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Bibi, Waaqni ishee haa boqochiisu, yeroo akkanaa akkana jetti turte: "yoon dubbadhe, arrabni koo guba; yoon hin dubbatin, dhuka lafee kootu guba."
items.q: Maman hesitates before criticising her husband. An old Persian proverb kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?
The family's New Year visits were cancelled; a brother jokes about it. An old Persian proverb kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: – Yaa nama kiyya, akka kanaatti isaaf hin ariitin, mataatti ol baʼa.
items.q: Does 'hin ariitin' mean don't talk to him so politely?
before: – Namni akkamitti dadhabbii fi rakkina isaa akkasumaan badu irratti hin gaddu?

items.text: – Hojiin isaa hundi gochawwan ajjeesan ture, namticha sana.
items.q: Is it clear that everything he did was suicidal, a danger to himself?
before: – Ee, ani asuman ture yeroo wanti sun taʼe.
Kolfi Farid dhumaa fuula koo dura bifa argata, foolii dhiigaa sammuu koo keessa maramus fakkii sana of duuba deebisa. Sagaleen Hooman karaa isaa kolfaa fi dhiiga gidduudhaan bane, gurra koo seena.

items.q: Hafez's line should allow two readings: 'real, not a metaphor' and 'not real, only a metaphor'. Can one line carry both? How?

items.text: Ergasii kitaabichi banamuun ija ishee bantee, gara fuula banamee ilaalte.
items.q: Is it clear that she opens the book herself, on purpose?
before: – ... A, ti, hin, taa, ne, ambishiyeeffataa. Kanaafuu maaloo haguuggii fi fakkeenya nagaa-jaalataa jala dhokachuu hin yaalin.

…– Waan tokko hin jenne. Garuu kaayyoon keenya maal akka ta'e beekta, jala kutuu hin dandeessu. Ija ishee cufattee, kitaaba qoma ishee dura qabattee, quba ishee akka kitaabicha bantutti kitaaba irra kaayatte. Hidhii jalaan hafuura xiqqaan ni jette: – Yaa Hafez Shiraaz, ati iccitii hunda beekta.
